rules.specification: Treat the listed forms as the standard spellings when abbreviating these units, not as a requirement to abbreviate. Apply the sentence-initial capitalisation exception to regulation and subregulation citations. Ordinary surrounding punctuation is not part of an abbreviation.

when: Applies only when a unit name is shortened.

For rules and subrules, the listed singular forms are ‘r’ and ‘subr’; the plural forms are ‘rr’ and ‘subrr’.
Regulation and subregulation citations are exempt from the lower-case requirement when they begin a sentence.
rules.why: G-2 and G-3: consolidate unit-specific shortened forms conditionally without requiring abbreviation; make the interpretation of the listed forms explicit.
